steps.what: Take off quantities stored on the model.
Draft the technical report from those quantities only.

loop.input: the quantity table and the report headings
loop.check: every figure cites a quantity in the table
loop.stop: stop when a figure cites nothing
loop.why_not_simpler: the report is prose, and a fixed sheet would invent a rate

steps.what: Prepare cost estimates, contracts, and bidding documents.
Store the pack for the architect or engineer to supervise.

tasks.design: Quantities already on the drawing model in {OTHER} are tabled with prices from the {ERP}. A report draft may cite only those quantities. The drafter prepares the cost estimates, contracts, and bidding documents. The stored pack is that version. The architect or engineer still supervises before anything is issued. A missing price stops the line.
tasks.previous_blocker: Quantities were retyped into a price sheet, and the report repeated a number from the wrong element.
tasks.enabler_now: Quantities on the model can be tabled, and a sentence can be held to them.
tasks.still_hard: A rate the price file does not hold, and a contract clause that is not a quantity.
tasks.human_edge: The drafter can see a quantity that is arithmetically right and the wrong element.

ambition.what: A project with quantities on the model gets an internal bidding pack in the same week, still for the architect or engineer to supervise.

tasks.altitude: The quantity table is ready. The pack is still prepared and checked by the drafter. Issue stays with the supervising architect or engineer.

reach.task: Supervise the estimate before it is issued.
reach.learn: The quantities can be tabled. The supervision is not this signature.

evidence.claim: Quantities on a model can be tabled, and a draft can be held to those figures. The drafter still prepares the contract pack.
A drafted sentence may cite only a figure or a clause already in the file. A sentence with neither stops. The architect or engineer supervises the issue. Storing the pack is not issuing it.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An architectural or civil drafter in a European practice. National building rules apply. A list does not issue a drawing.

Fields: Element id, quantity, and price id, produced by the model and the price file. A line with no price id is left open. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the drafter finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the model quantities and the price file the practice already keeps.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the drafter.
A drafted sentence may cite only a figure or a clause already in the file. A sentence with neither stops.
unknowns: Who supervises this project, the architect or the engineer.
research_questions: Are quantities reliable on the model?
What share of lines have no price?

already_counted.description: The drafter still prepares the bidding documents.

incremental.description: The drafter prices a line the file did not hold.

approvals.approved_version: pack version and the quantity ids the draft cites

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is the quantity table and a draft that cites it. It disappears when quantities are not on the model and the drafter measures by hand. The architect's supervision is outside this saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List design specifications and the material quantities.
Determine the procedures and instructions to follow.
Record the instructions the drafter set.

tasks.design: Design specifications and quantities already filed are listed from {DOCS}. The drafter determines the procedures and instructions to be followed. The list does not write the instruction. A specification that is not filed is not treated as covered.
tasks.previous_blocker: Instructions were a note on the last job's sheet, reused when the specification looked similar.
tasks.enabler_now: Filed specifications and quantities can be listed before the drafter writes.
tasks.still_hard: A method the specification leaves open, and a quantity that changes the sequence.
tasks.human_edge: The drafter can see a complete list and an instruction the site will misread.
tasks.altitude: The specification list is ready. The procedures are still determined by the drafter.

reach.task: Set the specification the procedure has to follow.
reach.learn: The list can be prepared. The instruction is still written here.

evidence.claim: A specification list can be opened. It cannot determine the procedure.
The instructions are the drafter's. A missing specification stops a claim that the procedure follows it.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An architectural or civil drafter in a European practice. National building rules apply. A list does not issue a drawing.

Fields: Specification id and quantity id, produced by the project file. A job with no specification id is not given a generated procedure. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the drafter finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the specification file the practice already keeps.
unknowns: Who else must agree an instruction.
Which instructions are site method rather than drawing method.
research_questions: What share of instructions are reused from the last job?

already_counted.description: The drafter still determines the procedures.

incremental.description: The drafter adds a specification the list missed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is the specification list. It disappears when the specification is unfiled and the drafter reads paper. Determining the procedure remains, so the net stays under the prior.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Judge materials and fill the list.

steps.what: Price the quantities from the materials price table.
Determine quality, strength, and quantity of required materials.
Enter the figures on the materials lists.

tasks.design: Quantities with a price id are costed from the {ERP} table. The drafter determines quality, cost, strength, and quantity of the required materials and enters the figures that person accepts. A line with no price is not given one. Strength is not taken from the price table.
tasks.previous_blocker: Costs were retyped, and strength was a note that did not match the figure on the list.
tasks.enabler_now: A price already in the table can be applied to a quantity that has an id.
tasks.still_hard: A material the table does not know, and a strength the specification leaves to the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The drafter can see a cheap line that is the wrong strength.
tasks.altitude: Known prices can be applied. Quality and strength stay with the drafter. The list holds only accepted figures.

reach.task: Confirm strength where the drafter must not decide it.
reach.learn: The price can be looked up. The strength judgement is shared upward.

evidence.claim: A price table can cost a quantity that has an id. It cannot judge quality or strength.
Entering a figure is the drafter's act after that judgement. A missing price stops the line rather than inventing a cost.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An architectural or civil drafter in a European practice. National building rules apply. A list does not issue a drawing.

Fields: Material id, quantity, and price id, produced by the model and the price table. A material with no id is not priced. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the drafter finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the price table the practice already keeps.
research_questions: What share of materials have a price id?
How often is a priced line the wrong grade?

already_counted.description: The drafter still judges quality and strength.
The drafter still enters the figures.

incremental.description: The drafter adds a price the table did not hold.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is pricing lines that already have a price id. It disappears when ids are missing and the drafter prices by hand. The strength judgement remains, so the net stays under the prior.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Draw freehand and letter the sheets.

steps.what: Open the sheets that need lettering.
Create the freehand drawings and the lettering.
Check the lettering accompanies the right drawing.

tasks.design: Sheets that still need lettering are listed from {PROJECT}. The drafter creates the freehand drawings and the lettering to accompany them. A font on a title block is not that lettering. The list does not draw. A sheet not on the list is still lettered if the drafter sees it is bare.
tasks.previous_blocker: Lettering was left until print day, and a note landed on the wrong view.
tasks.enabler_now: The sheets still missing lettering can be listed. The hand work is unchanged.
tasks.still_hard: A note that has to sit in a crowded view, and a freehand sketch the model cannot hold.
tasks.human_edge: The drafter can place a word so the drawing stays readable.
tasks.altitude: The list can show bare sheets. Freehand drawing and lettering stay with the drafter.

reach.task: Expect lettering that belongs to the drawing, not only to the title.
reach.learn: The list can name a sheet. The hand work cannot.

evidence.claim: A list can name sheets. It cannot create freehand drawings or lettering.

Producing the drawing stays with the drafter. A rule list does not pass a design. An engineer signs a code conclusion. For a new class 1 building, an independent kwaliteitsborger still tests against the building rules. This list does not replace that test.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An architectural or civil drafter in a European practice. National building rules apply. A list does not issue a drawing.
Fields: Sheet id, produced by the project index. A sheet with no id is not listed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the drafter finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the project index the practice already keeps. No new tool draws the freehand work.
unknowns: Which notes must be hand lettered.
research_questions: What share of lettering is still freehand?
Which sheets are missed until print?

already_counted.description: The drafter still draws and letters.

incremental.description: The drafter adds a sheet the list marked done.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is the list of sheets. It disappears when the index is wrong and the drafter looks through the set. The freehand time is unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Quantities can be taken from the model. The drafter still prepares the estimate under supervision, still sets the procedure, and still draws freehand.
reach: Civil engineers supervise the estimate, and this job learns a quantity is not the contract.
Architects expect freehand lettering to stay a drawing, not a font on a title block.
skills_to_grow: Cite an estimate sentence only to a quantity in the file.
Keep quality and strength as a judgement even when the count is calculated.
role.ambitious_version: A bidding pack can be assembled from quantities the same week, and the architect or engineer still supervises the issue.
